name: deepseek-minimal-anchor
description: Task-aware mini-router for DeepSeek models in Codex: classifies spec/react mode, injects the matching persona at session start, adapts per-turn guidance to task complexity, and reports a trajectory fingerprint.

interface.shortDescription: Give DeepSeek Pro a task-aware spec/react mini-router in Codex.
interface.longDescription: DeepSeek models are highly sensitive to the agent scaffold and to the first-visible persona. This plugin classifies each task (spec: plan-and-fix, react: build-and-verify), locks the mode per session, injects the matching persona at session start, and adapts per-turn guidance to task complexity. DeepSeek Flash models get a separate weak-mode persona with recall/anti-runaway/decision-closure anchors. Delivery: hooks inject the contract as developer context on desktop and CLI once trusted (trust is hash-keyed - re-trust after updates); the bundled skill is a self-executing fallback that carries the same contract when hooks are not running. Codex hides reasoning, so verification uses visible behavior: reply count, final-summary shape, tool-call pace, an audit log of every injection, and opportunistic let-me/we counts when a gateway passes reasoning through.
defaultPrompt: Show the trajectory fingerprint for this session.
Enable the DeepSeek mini-router (trust its hooks) and confirm it is active.
